zh-CN.title: 桌面位置浮层精细化
items: 位置浮层现在清晰展示坐标与定位精度，并保留精确和模糊发送

items: The location popover now presents coordinates and accuracy clearly with precise and approximate sending
Footprint and voice popovers now open fully within the conversation frame
